text.description:
{Pirate Boots}

Allows the hero to rearrange their troops within an additional 2 rows of the commanding hero before combat. If the hero doesn't have the Tactics skill, allows the hero to rearrange their troops within 3 rows of the commanding hero before combat.
text.event: You decide to go fishing, but the best you can get is a pair of boots.
text.name: Pirate Boots
